Home for the Howlidays

Every product photo was checked against the inspiration image and prices were read from the live listings on Nov 13, 2026, so confirm them at checkout. Every decoration in the 3D view is a cutout of the real product photo at its real size; tap one to see the listing. DIY items are made by the committee, and their totals are the cost of materials. Every ornament gets secured with floral wire, and there's no tree skirt (the organizers cover the base).
